scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:openapi && npm test && npm run build
scripts.audit:production: npm audit --omit=dev --prefix client && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix server
scripts.docker:config: docker compose config && docker compose -f docker-compose.production.yml config
